name: youtube_chat_server
description: WebSocket server for YouTube live chat streaming

scripts.build:all: npm run bundle && pkg dist/server.cjs --targets node20-win-x64 --output ../public/downloads/youtube_chat_server_win-x64 && pkg dist/server.cjs --targets node20-macos-x64 --output ../public/downloads/youtube_chat_server_macos-x64 && npm run zip
scripts.build:win: npm run bundle && pkg dist/server.cjs --targets node20-win-x64 --output ../public/downloads/youtube_chat_server_win-x64 && npm run zip
scripts.build:mac: npm run bundle && pkg dist/server.cjs --targets node20-macos-x64 --output ../public/downloads/youtube_chat_server_macos-x64 && npm run zip
